sourceFindings: Q5(b) listening accepts 23 céim Celsius OR 29 céim Celsius; both are explicitly accepted by the SEC. Keep one eight-mark task with both answers.
Q6(a) listening accepts Fuair sí fáinne cluaise eile OR Tá fáinne ina srón aici. Keep one ten-mark task with both answers.
Q3A(5) accepts sciliúil/láidir/tapa/cabhrach/cairdiúil. Q3B(5) accepts travel-related alternatives. These are source answers, not closed printed task menus.

4A is the Grease musical notice with Ryan Tubridy and Trócaire. Allocations: layout 1; picture 1 10; picture 2 13; picture 3 5; picture 4 5; shared Gaeilge 11. Picture 3 guidance is on scheme page 9, picture 4 on page 10.

4B is a letter to a friend about a hotel job, not an application form. Layout: address 2/date 1/greeting 1/closing 2; each of four pictures 7 (two points at 4+3); shared Gaeilge 11. Keep the entire response together.
5A is the camping holiday and 5B the match at Páirc an Chrócaigh. Each is one response: communication 34 and shared Gaeilge 11, with the published length table 80–90:0, 60–79:−2, 30–59:−3, <30:−4.

The 5A/5B scheme headings show Tagairt NR/-12; their prose separately specifies −4 per missing reference and communication ceilings 34,30,26,22,18,14. Preserve both verbatim; do not invent an additional automatic deduction from that abbreviated heading.
The scheme page 7 writing header says 45 marks, but the paper explicitly requires two 45-mark answers (90). The four question schemes and paper instructions determine the candidate total.
Every full poem, passage, sign grid, map and four-picture writing sequence must remain accessible. Scheme transcript pages 17–19 are answer material, never listening source prompts.
